name: ledger-wallet-cli
description: Optional Wallet CLI Harness integration backed by the official wallet-cli 1.0.2 JSON contract and a local stdio MCP adapter.

interface.shortDescription: Use Ledger hardware wallets through the official wallet-cli.
interface.longDescription: Adds the Wallet CLI Harness scripts, strict flag validation, NDJSON result parsing, and an MCP adapter for Ledger's official wallet-cli without embedding Ledger-specific commands or UI in AgenC core.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Ledger Wallet CLI session safely.
